data.name: AR-11 Arbitrator
data.description: The AR-11 Arbitrator is a Primary Assault Rifle equipped with an underbarrel shotgun.

data.name: AR-2 Coyote
data.description: The AR-2 Coyote is a Primary Assault Rifle that fires Medium armor penetration incendiary rounds.

data.name: AR-23 Liberator
data.description: The AR-23 Liberator is a Primary Assault Rifle, available for all Helldivers.

data.name: AR-23A Liberator Carbine
data.description: The AR-23A Liberator Carbine is a Primary Assault Rifle, a carbine variant of the standard Liberator, featuring a much faster fire rate at the cost of significantly increased recoil.

data.name: AR-23C Liberator Concussive
data.description: The AR-23C Liberator Concussive is Primary Assault Rifle, a variant of the standard Liberator with a drum magazine and increased stagger power in exchange for a significantly reduced rate of fire.

data.name: AR-23P Liberator Penetrator
data.description: The AR-23P Liberator Penetrator is a Primary Assault Rifle, a variant of the standard Liberator with increased armor-piercing capabilities.

data.name: AR-32 Pacifier
data.description: The AR-32 Pacifier is a Primary Assault Rifle that fires Medium armor penetration stun rounds in exchange for significantly low damage output.

data.name: AR-59 Suppressor
data.description: The AR-59 Suppressor is a Primary Assault Rifle, equipped with a suppressor for silent takedowns, especially suited to Stealth playstyles.

data.name: AR-61 Tenderizer
data.description: The AR-61 Tenderizer is a Primary Assault Rifle that fires Light-armor penetrating high-caliber rounds. It boasts the highest damage per round in its class.

data.name: AR/GL-21 One-Two
data.description: The AR/GL-21 One-Two is a Primary Assault Rifle equipped with an underbarrel grenade launcher.

data.name: ARC-12 Blitzer
data.description: The ARC-12 Blitzer is an Primary Energy-Based shotgun that fires arcs of electricity instead of buckshot.

data.name: BR-14 Adjudicator
data.description: The BR-14 Adjudicator is a Primary Assault Rifle. It fires Medium armor penetrating rounds with high damage, but has a restricted magazine size and moderate recoil.

data.name: CB-9 Exploding Crossbow
data.description: The CB-9 Exploding Crossbow is a Primary Explosive weapon. It fires explosive-tipped crossbow bolts that deal damage in an area.

data.name: CQC-19 Stun Lance
data.description: The CQC-19 Stun Lance is a Melee Secondary Weapon. Attacking will thrust the lance at a moderately fast speed.

statsRaw.Traits: Medium Armor Penetrating • One Handed • Stun • Melee

data.name: CQC-2 Saber
data.description: The CQC-2 Saber is a Melee Secondary Weapon. Attacking will rapidly swing the saber in a short range.

statsRaw.Traits: Medium Armor Penetrating • One Handed • Melee

data.name: CQC-30 Stun Baton
data.description: The CQC-30 Stun Baton is a Melee Secondary Weapon. Attacking will rapidly swing the baton in a short range.

statsRaw.Traits: Medium Armor Penetrating • One Handed • Stun • Melee

data.name: CQC-42 Machete
data.description: The CQC-42 Machete is a Melee Secondary Weapon. Attacking will slowly swing the Machete in a short range.

statsRaw.Traits: Medium Armor Penetrating • One Handed • Melee

data.name: CQC-5 Combat Hatchet
data.description: The CQC-5 Combat Hatchet is a Melee Secondary Weapon. Attacking will rapidly swing the hatchet in a short range.

statsRaw.Traits: Medium Armor Penetrating • One Handed • Melee

data.name: Trench Shovel
data.description: The CQC-72 Entrenchment Tool, is a Melee Support Weapon that doubles as a shovel.

data.name: Entrenchment Tool
data.description: The CQC-73 Entrenchment Tool is a Melee Secondary Weapon that doubles as a shovel.

data.name: DBS-2 Double Freedom
data.description: The DBS-2 Double Freedom is a double-barreled Primary Shotgun, compensating its limited capacity with massive stopping power.

data.name: FLAM-66 Torcher
data.description: The FLAM-66 Torcher is a Primary Special flamethrower.

data.name: G-10 Incendiary
data.description: The G-10 Incendiary is a Standard Throwable that trades direct explosive damage for lingering fire, causing enemies to take damage over time.

data.name: G-109 Urchin
data.description: The G-109 Urchin is a Special Throwable that can stick and inflict stun to a single target after a delay.

data.name: G-12 High Explosive
data.description: The G-12 High Explosive is a Standard Throwable with a high damaging, heavy armor penetrating explosion.

data.name: G-123 Thermite
data.description: The G-123 Thermite is a Special Throwable that can stick and inflict heavy explosion damage to a single target after a delay.

data.name: G-13 Incendiary Impact
data.description: The G-13 Incendiary Impact is a Special Throwable that combines the characteristics of the G-16 Impact and G-10 Incendiary.

data.name: G-142 Pyrotech
data.description: The G-142 Pyrotech is a Special Throwable that trades direct explosive damage for lingering fire, causing enemies to take damage over time.

data.name: G-16 Impact
data.description: The G-16 Impact is a Special Throwable that explodes on impact with a surface or entity.

data.name: G-23 Stun
data.description: The G-23 Stun is a Special Throwable that creates a non-lethal explosion, stunning enemies and slowing Helldivers.

data.name: G-3 Smoke
data.description: The G-3 Smoke is a Special Throwable that is used to create a temporary smoke screen to obscure Helldivers.

data.name: G-31 Arc
data.description: The G-31 Arc is a Special Throwable that fires arcs in a similar manner to the De-Escalator.

data.name: G-4 Gas
data.description: The G-4 Gas (or Gas Grenade) is a Special Throwable that releases a cloud of Gas alongside a minuscule explosion.

data.name: G/40-K Melta Mine
data.description: The G/40-K Melta Mine is a Standard Throwable that deploys a proximity mine which, when detonated, releases a large column of superheated thermal energy before exploding.

data.name: G-48 Giga Grenade
data.description: The G-48 Giga Grenade is a Special Throwable with a wide and high damaging explosion, at the cost of less than usual grenade capacity.

data.name: G-50 Seeker
data.description: The G-50 Seeker (simply known as a Seeker) is a Special Throwable in Helldivers 2 that can fly around and explodes on impact. It will target the nearest enemy, but will prioritize a pinged enemy.

data.name: G-6 Frag
data.description: The G-6 Frag is a Standard Throwable with a large explosive radius, producing shrapnel that can deal additional damage.

data.name: G-60 Anti-Tank Seeker
data.description: The G-60 Anti-Tank Seeker (also known as the AT Seeker) is a Special Throwable in Helldivers 2. Similar to the G-50 Seeker, it is an anti-tank grenade that can fly and will explode on impact.

data.name: G-7 Pineapple
data.description: The G-7 Pineapple is a Standard Throwable that explodes into several bomblets with shrapnel, able to inflict damage over a large area.

data.name: G-8 Immolation
data.description: The G-8 Immolation is a Special Throwable that explodes into a massive pool of fire upon impact.

data.name: G-89 Smokescreen
data.description: The G-89 Smokescreen is a Special Throwable that is used to create a temporary smoke screen to obscure Helldivers upon impact.

data.name: G/SH-39 Shield
data.description: The G/SH-39 Shield is a Special Throwable that projects a small bubble shield with 360° coverage to block incoming projectiles.

data.name: GL-15 Evictor
data.description: GL-15 Evictor is a Explosive primary weapon that fires high-damaging grenades that explode upon impact. The pump handle chambers each round, similar to a pump-action shotgun.

data.name: GP-20 Ultimatum
data.description: The Ultimatum is a Secondary Special, powerful single-shot weapon that fires extremely destructive explosive rounds.

data.name: GP-31 Grenade Pistol
data.description: The GP-31 Grenade Pistol is a Secondary Special single-shot weapon that fires a powerful grenades at a medium range.

data.name: JAR-5 Dominator
data.description: The JAR-5 Dominator is a Primary Special weapon that fires highly damaging rounds in exchange for a severely restricted magazine size.

data.name: K-2 Throwing Knife
data.description: The K-2 Throwing Knife is a Special Throwable that can be used for silent takedowns, especially suited to Stealth playstyles.

data.name: LAS-13 Trident
data.description: The LAS-13 Trident is a Primary Energy-Based shotgun in Helldivers 2. It fires multiple beams per shot and ammunition capacity is only limited by heat accumulation within the weapon.

data.name: LAS-16 Sickle
data.description: The LAS-16 Sickle is a Primary Energy-Based weapon that operates like an Assault Rifle, shooting targets with a barrage of laser pulses.

data.name: LAS-17 Double-Edge Sickle
data.description: The LAS-17 Double-Edge Sickle is a Primary Energy-Based weapon that operates like an assault rifle, shooting targets with a barrage of laser pulses but will damage the user after prolonged firing.

statsRaw.Traits: Light Armor Penetrating • Medium Armor Penetrating • Heavy Armor Penetrating • Heat

data.name: LAS-5 Scythe
data.description: The LAS-5 Scythe is a Primary Energy-Based laser rifle with infinite ammo. The weapons ammunition capacity is only limited by heat accumulation within the weapon.

data.name: LAS-58 Talon
data.description: The LAS-58 Talon is a Secondary Special, energy-based semi-automatic laser revolver that fires pulses similarly to the LAS-16 Sickle.

statsRaw.Traits: One Handed • Heat • Medium Armor Penetrating

data.name: LAS-7 Dagger
data.description: The LAS-7 Dagger is a Secondary Special energy-based laser pistol with infinite ammo. The weapons ammunition capacity is only limited by heat accumulation within the weapon.

statsRaw.Traits: Light Armor Penetrating • One Handed • Beam • Heat

data.name: M6C/SOCOM Pistol
data.description: The M6C/SOCOM Pistol is a Secondary Pistol with a suppressor and relatively high damage for silent takedowns, especially suited to Stealth playstyles. Part of Helldivers 2 x Halo: ODST crossover.

statsRaw.Traits: Light Armor Penetrating • One Handed • Suppressed

data.name: M7S SMG
data.description: The M7S SMG is a Primary Submachine Gun with a moderate rate of fire and suppressor for silent takedowns, especially suited to Stealth playstyles. Part of Helldivers 2 x Halo: ODST crossover.

statsRaw.Traits: Light Armor Penetrating • One Handed • Suppressed

data.name: M90A Shotgun
data.description: The M90A Shotgun is a Primary Shotgun, able to inflict extremely high damage per round in exchange for a significantly reduced magazine size.

data.name: MA5C Assault Rifle
data.description: The MA5C Assault Rifle is a Primary Assault Rifle. It has an attached electronics suite that provides information on rounds remaining in the magazine and compass heading.

data.name: MP-98 Knight
data.description: The MP-98 Knight is a Primary Submachine Gun with an extremely high rate of fire.

data.name: P-11 Stim Pistol
data.description: The P-11 Stim Pistol is a Secondary Special weapon that fires healing Stim rounds.

data.name: P-113 Verdict
data.description: The P-113 Verdict is a Secondary Pistol that inflicts high damage per round in exchange for a reduced magazine size.

data.name: P-19 Redeemer
data.description: The P-19 Redeemer is a semi-automatic and fully-automatic hybrid Secondary Pistol.

data.name: P-2 Peacemaker
data.description: The P-2 Peacemaker is the starting Secondary Pistol for every Helldiver.

data.name: P-33 Missile Pistol
data.description: The P-33 Missile Pistol is a Secondary Special single-shot weapon that fires guided missiles at targets.

statsRaw.Traits: Medium Armor Penetrating • Anti-Tank • One Handed • Guided • Explosive

data.name: P-34 Breacher
data.description: The P-34 Breacher is a Special Secondary single-shot weapon that fires an explosive thermite projectile at targets.

data.name: P-35 Re-Educator
data.description: The P-35 Re-Educator is a Secondary Special pistol that fires Gas darts to disorient enemies.

statsRaw.Traits: One Handed • Caustic • Heavy Armor Penetrating

data.name: P-4 Senator
data.description: The P-4 Senator is a Secondary Pistol that can penetrate heavy armor and deals a very high amount of damage per shot.

statsRaw.Traits: Heavy Armor Penetrating • One Handed • Rounds Reload

data.name: P/40-K Bolt Pistol
data.description: The P/40-K Bolt Pistol is a Secondary Pistol that fires large caliber rounds with massive recoil.

statsRaw.Traits: Heavy Armor Penetrating • Explosive • One Handed

data.name: P-69 Veto
data.description: The P-69 Veto is a Secondary Pistol with an internal magazine and jet-assisted rounds, able to inflict high stagger to enemies.

statsRaw.Traits: Medium Armor Penetrating • One Handed • Rounds Reload

data.name: P-72 Crisper
data.description: The P-72 Crisper is a Secondary Special handheld flamethrower that can be wielded in one hand.

data.name: P-92 Warrant
data.description: The P-92 Warrant is a Secondary Pistol. It has the ability to target enemies with homing bullets whilst shooting in a three-round burst.

statsRaw.Traits: Medium Armor Penetrating • One Handed • Guided

data.name: PLAS-1 Scorcher
data.description: The PLAS-1 Scorcher is a Primary Energy-Based weapon that fires explosive energy projectiles.

data.name: PLAS-101 Purifier
data.description: The PLAS-101 Purifier is a Primary Energy-Based weapon that can fire variable-charge bolts of gas.

statsRaw.Standard Damage: 100 Uncharged Bolt / 75 Uncharged Explosion / 200 Charged Bolt / 300 Charged Explosion

data.name: PLAS-15 Loyalist
data.description: The PLAS-15 Loyalist is a Secondary Special pistol that fires explosive plasma projectiles.

statsRaw.Traits: Medium Armor Penetrating • One Handed • Explosive • Chargeup

data.name: PLAS-39 Accelerator Rifle
data.description: The PLAS-39 Accelerator Rifle is a Primary Energy-Based, burst-firing plasma sniper rifle. It is part of the Helldivers 2 x Killzone Legendary Warbond or the Helldivers x Killzone crossover package.

data.name: R-2 Amendment
data.description: The R-2 Amendment is a Primary Marksman Rifle that can fire in semi-automatic or three-round bursts modes. It is affixed with a bayonet, improving melee damage and range.

data.name: R-2124 Constitution
data.description: The R-2124 Constitution is a bolt-action Primary Marksman Rifle reminiscent of pre-Democratic rifles. It is affixed with a bayonet, improving melee damage and range.

data.name: R-36 Eruptor
data.description: R-36 Eruptor is a Primary Explosive weapon that fires jet-assisted shells which explode into shrapnel on impact.

data.name: R-4 Hyena
data.description: The R-4 Hyena is a Primary Marksman Rifle similar to the R-63CS Diligence Counter Sniper, trading magazine count, fire rate, and handling for greater firepower and incendiary rounds.

data.name: R/40-K Hot-Shot Marksman Rifle
data.description: The R/40-K Hot-Shot Marksman Rifle is a Primary Energy-Based Marksman Rifle that fires high-damaging bolts of energy, capable of cleaving through enemies.

data.name: R-6 Deadeye
data.description: The R-6 Deadeye is a lever-action Primary Marksman Rifle that trades rate-of-fire for Medium armor penetration, high damage and stagger force, requiring users to aim well and hit their targets the first time.

data.name: R-63 Diligence
data.description: The R-63 Diligence is a Primary Marksman Rifle that fires Light armor penetrating, but highly damaging shots.

data.name: R-63CS Diligence Counter Sniper
data.description: The R-63CS Diligence Counter Sniper is a Primary Marksman Rifle similar to the R-63 Diligence, trading magazine size and handling for greater firepower that can damage Medium armor.

data.name: R-72 Censor
data.description: The R-72 Censor is a Primary Marksman Rifle equipped with a suppressor for silent takedowns, specially suited for Stealth playstyles.

data.name: SG-20 Halt
data.description: The SG-20 Halt is a dual-tube, pump-action Primary Shotgun. It can switch between Medium-armor penetrating flechettes and Light-armor penetrating stun pellets.

statsRaw.Traits: Light Armor Penetrating • Medium Armor Penetrating • Rounds Reload

data.name: SG-22 Bushwhacker
data.description: The SG-22 Bushwhacker is Secondary Special triple-barreled shotgun.

statsRaw.Traits: Light Armor Penetrating • One Handed • Rounds Reload

data.name: SG-225 Breaker
data.description: The SG-225 Breaker is a fully-automatic, mag-fed Primary Shotgun that is able to dish out tremendous amounts of damage in a short period of time.

data.name: SG-225IE Breaker Incendiary
data.description: The SG-225IE Breaker Incendiary is a burst fire Primary Shotgun, a variant of the standard Breaker that fires incendiary buckshot.

data.name: SG-225SP Breaker Spray&Pray
data.description: The SG-225SP Breaker Spray&Pray is a fully-automatic Primary Shotgun, a variant of the standard Breaker that fires a wide and mostly horizontal spread of birdshot pellets.

data.name: SG-451 Cookout
data.description: The SG-451 Cookout is a Primary Shotgun, a variant of the standard Punisher that fires incendiary buckshot.

statsRaw.Traits: Light Armor Penetrating • Rounds Reload • Incendiary

data.name: SG-8 Punisher
data.description: The SG-8 Punisher is a Primary Shotgun, possessing high damage and stagger per shot, at the cost of a low overall fire rate.

data.name: SG-88 Break-Action Shotgun
data.description: The SG-88 Break-Action Shotgun is a Support Weapon with a 2 shot capacity found on various planets from Super Earth colonists.

statsRaw.Traits: Support Weapon • Light Armor Penetrating • Rounds Reload

data.name: SG-8P Punisher Plasma
data.description: The SG-8P Punisher Plasma is a Primary Energy-Based weapon, a variant of the standard Punisher that fires Medium armor penetrating, exploding plasma rounds.

data.name: SG-8S Slugger
data.description: The SG-8S Slugger is a Primary Shotgun, a variant of the standard Punisher that fires Medium armor penetrating slugs, as opposed to buckshot. This means the shotgun acts more like a rifle, firing a single projectile per shot.

data.name: SG-97 Sweeper
data.description: The SG-97 Sweeper is a Primary Shotgun with Medium armor penetrating flechettes, able to inflict high damage per round in exchange for a significantly reduced magazine size. It is affixed with a bayonet, improving melee damage and range.

data.name: SMG-203 Gallant
data.description: The SMG-203 Gallant is a variant of the MP-98 Knight that sacrifices damage in exchange for Medium armor penetration.

data.name: SMG-32 Reprimand
data.description: The SMG-32 Reprimand is a Primary Submachine Gun with high damage and Medium armor penetration in exchange for restricted magazine size.

data.name: SMG-37 Defender
data.description: The SMG-37 Defender is a Primary Submachine Gun with a moderate rate of fire.

data.name: SMG-72 Pummeler
data.description: The SMG-72 Pummeler is a Primary Submachine Gun that fires concussive rounds that can stun enemies.

data.name: SMG/FLAM-34 Stoker
data.description: The SMG/FLAM-34 Stoker is a Primary Submachine Gun that comes equipped with an under-barrel flamethrower.

statsRaw.Traits: Light Armor Penetrating • One Handed • Incendiary

data.name: StA-11 SMG
data.description: The StA-11 SMG is a Primary Submachine Gun with an extremely high rate of fire. It is part of the Helldivers 2 x Killzone Legendary Warbond or the Helldivers x Killzone crossover package.

data.name: StA-52 Assault Rifle
data.description: The StA-52 Assault Rifle is a Primary Assault Rifle with a drum magazine. It is part of the Helldivers 2 x Killzone Legendary Warbond or the Helldivers x Killzone crossover package.

data.name: TED-63 Dynamite
data.description: The TED-63 Dynamite is a Standard Throwable with a wide and high damaging explosion, at the cost of a longer than usual fuse. Uniquely, it has a programmable fuse timer which can be changed via the weapon wheel.

data.name: TM-1 Lure Mine
data.description: The TM-1 Lure Mine is a Special Throwable that lures in enemies before proximity detonating with a high damage explosion and shrapnel.

data.name: VG-70 Variable
data.description: VG-70 Variable is a Primary Special weapon. It is a seven-barrelled volley gun with three different firing modes: Auto, Volley, and Total, as well as variable rpm options.
